Based on the text provided, the primary bottleneck is the inefficient logistics of tool and material retrieval. The construction crew relies on a single central repository, forcing workers to travel significant distances across the site. This results in lost productivity due to excessive time spent commuting between the repository and various construction areas.

To improve efficiency, AutoBuild should consider decentralizing resources by establishing smaller, localized storage points or tool caches closer to active work zones. This would reduce travel time, minimize downtime, and allow workers to focus more on construction tasks rather than logistics.
